rows.rationale: ManagedAccount is one broad runtime DTO containing contact, recovery-phone, temporary-password and credential-revision fields. getStaffAccounts calls requireStaff before and after reading and its SQL subquery binds the live session, expiry, credential revision, temporary-password gate, active membership, ban and role; Admin can list non-self roles while Staff can list Members only. requireManagedAccount only loads the target, rejects missing/self targets, and rejects non-Members only when actor.role === "staff"; it does not reread the actor session or revision. Admin may target other roles subject to operation-specific policy. Current authority stays with requireStaff/requireSensitiveStaff callers and command-time SQL assertions. ST16 should add bounded list/detail projections without changing these rules.
rows.depth: Full 170-line semantic read; all direct src callers and live/SQL-time authority owners traced.
rows.limitations: No D1 query-plan, HTTP payload, RSC payload or browser qualification.

findings.finding: R1 names bounded list/detail reads and current-authority denial but does not state the current Staff list/target split. getStaffAccounts requires a live active, unbanned Staff/Admin session with matching credential revision and no temporary password, excludes self, and exposes all non-self roles only to Admin; Staff can list Members only. requireManagedAccount itself only loads the target, rejects missing/self, and rejects non-Members when actor.role === "staff"; it does not reread live session/revision. requireStaff/requireSensitiveStaff callers and the command-time sensitiveStaffAssertion own current authority. Admin may target other roles subject to operation-specific policy.
findings.action: Carry the exact list and operation target policy into ST16/ST21 acceptance; retain caller-level live authority and SQL-time checks. Do not expand roles or permissions.

findings.finding: R1 names receipts, short-lived secrets and route preservation but does not record the exact Staff account mutation envelope: new create/reset/reissue returns 201 with temporaryPassword and expiry; idempotent replay returns 200 receipt-only; reconcile returns 200. Each mutation/reconcile POST has its action-specific business guard; the GET list is separately authorized by getStaffAccounts and returns an unbounded list.
findings.action: Carry exact POST status/body/secret-omission semantics into ST12/ST16 qualification, and add the ST16/ST06 page bound to the existing mounted GET endpoint.

findings.finding: R1 requires a 25-row Staff account list and server-bounded reads, but mounted GET /staff/accounts serializes all permitted accounts in one response; the Staff page also calls the broad helper directly. No in-repo GET client was found, but that does not establish external non-use. ST16/ST06 must add pagination to this existing endpoint and bound the shared list query and response.
findings.action: Keep GET /staff/accounts mounted and add a reachable 25-row pagination contract through the shared bounded list owner; preserve the existing mutation POST envelopes.

findings.finding: R1 preserves late-response disposal and no retry in prose, but does not state the concrete shared client contract: always-online request, staleTime/gcTime zero, retry false and exact query removal after settlement, while domain key/read/actor/outcome remain feature-owned.
findings.action: Carry as a shared-mechanics invariant during workflow refactors; do not unify feature policy.

findings.finding: R1 mentions refresh/revalidation and safe navigation, but does not explicitly capture that unavailable reads render no partial data, retry through native GET with preserved query params, and status recheck performs a full server refresh with no cached authorization.
findings.action: Carry as ST21/ST24 acceptance evidence; keep the existing neutral display owners.

findings.finding: R1 preserves Home date controls and retained-history ordering, but does not explicitly name the shared Asia/Hong_Kong calendar-key, Monday-first week and 24-hour retained timestamp contract.
findings.action: Carry as a preservation locator when changing Home/history/page composition; no new time feature.

findings.finding: R1 says URLs/query/target keys remain stable, but the actual Staff workspace route inventory is owned by workItems/tabs/staffPeopleHref and includes view=people, task=create/recovery/identity/restrictions/deletion, person, q and audit/application destinations.
findings.action: Use the inventory as ST21 route/entrypoint review evidence; do not create a generated router.
